title: Host's trifield meter drained at Skinwalker Ranch
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Host's trifield meter drained at Skinwalker Ranch, about unspecified (host's visit) at Skinwalker Ranch, Uintah Basin, Utah, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I remember being at Skinwalker rch which is this famous kind of paranormal Hots spot in the uent you know Basin in Utah and a trifield meter going off right before we left we grabbed the trifield meters it had full battery it's flashing it's now dead

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he visited Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah's Uintah Basin famous for paranormal reports. He says that just before his group left, a trifield meter, a device that measures electric and magnetic fields, started going off, and that although it had a full battery when they picked it up, it was flashing and then dead. He tells it as an example of the strange effects people report at the ranch.
